scope: Read-only final-client dependency preparation; no game launched

metadata.META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml:
modLoader="javafml"
loaderVersion="[4,)"
issueTrackerURL="https://github.com/bernie-g/geckolib/issues"
license="MIT"

[[mods]]
    modId="geckolib"
    version="4.9.2"
    displayName="GeckoLib 4"
    displayURL="http://geckolib.com/"
    logoFile="geckolib.png"
    credits="Gecko, Eliot, AzureDoom, DerToaster, Tslat, Witixin"
    authors="Gecko, Eliot, AzureDoom, DerToaster, Tslat, Witixin"
    description='''
GeckoLib is an animation engine for Minecraft Mods, with support for complex 3D keyframe-based animations, 30+ easings, concurrent animation support, sound and particle keyframes, event keyframes, and more.
'''

[[mixins]]
    config = "geckolib.mixins.json"

[[accessTransformers]]
    file = "META-INF/accesstransformer.cfg"

[[dependencies.geckolib]]
    modId="neoforge"
    type="required"
    versionRange="[21.1.150,)"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"
[[dependencies.geckolib]]
    modId="minecraft"
    type="required"
    versionRange="[1.21,)"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"
[[dependencies.geckolib]]
    modId="geckoanimfix"
    type="incompatible"
    side="BOTH"

modLoader = "javafml" #mandatory
loaderVersion = "[4,)" #mandatory
license = "MIT" # Review your options at https://choosealicense.com/.
#issueTrackerURL="https://change.me.to.your.issue.tracker.example.invalid/" #optional
[[mods]] #mandatory
modId = "aaa_particles" #mandatory
version = "2.3.3" #mandatory
displayName = "AAA Particles" #mandatory
#updateJSONURL="https://change.me.example.invalid/updates.json" #optional (see https://docs.neoforged.net/docs/misc/updatechecker/)
#displayURL="https://change.me.to.your.mods.homepage.example.invalid/" #optional (displayed in the mod UI)
logoFile="aaa_particles.png" #optional
credits="" #optional
authors = "ChloePrime" #optional
description = '''Effekseer for Minecraft''' #mandatory (Supports multiline text)
[[mixins]]
config = "aaa_particles.mixins.json"
[[mixins]]
config = "aaa_particles-common.mixins.json"
[[dependencies.aaa_particles]] #optional
modId = "neoforge" #mandatory
type="required" #mandatory (Can be one of "required", "optional", "incompatible" or "discouraged")
versionRange = "[21.1.169,)" #mandatory
ordering = "NONE" # The order that this dependency should load in relation to your mod, required to be either 'BEFORE' or 'AFTER' if the dependency is not mandatory
side = "BOTH" # Side this dependency is applied on - 'BOTH', 'CLIENT' or 'SERVER'
[[dependencies.aaa_particles]]
modId = "minecraft"
type="required" #mandatory (Can be one of "required", "optional", "incompatible" or "discouraged")
versionRange = "[1.21, 1.21.2)"
ordering = "NONE"
side = "BOTH"

#[features.aaa_particles]
#openGLVersion="[3.2,)"

findings: GeckoLib 4.9.2 requires NeoForge >=21.1.150 and Minecraft >=1.21; geckoanimfix is incompatible; no jarjar metadata.
AAA Particles 2.3.3 requires NeoForge >=21.1.169 and Minecraft [1.21,1.21.2); architectury-neoforge 13.0.8 is embedded.
Both located target jars satisfy the target and NeoForge Preview runtime version requirements.
The limited AAA coordinate cache contains no Forge 1.20.1-compatible jar; no claim about all local disks.
Preview still pins GeckoLib 4.8.4 and takes one previewHpJar; final runtime configuration is pending.
